ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Locker 1 belongs to the whale. ... Locker 8 belongs to the goose. ... Locker 5 belongs to the pig. ... In which locker does the animal known for honking keep its things?" -> answer org 8; the alt prompt asks about the pig (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: 5 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 1 (answer at the same statement slot), 9 (the alt prompt's own answer), 8 (answer org kept).
